home.hero_desc: A unified platform for procurement, inventory, and order fulfillment — powered by AI, simulation, and real-time intelligence.
home.workflow_subtitle: Connected deterministic priority scheduling, human governance, and explainable inventory distribution.
home.step_1_desc: Customer placing hardware orders with requested quantities, partial delivery flags, and minimum threshold constraints.
home.step_2_desc: Evaluates order comments and historical patterns to recommend priority tier. Critical lock-in with human governance.
home.step_3_desc: Evaluates hard inventory thresholds by approved priority, promised date, and order age with zero-over allocation guarantee.
home.step_4_desc: Inspect execution before-and-after causality, monitor shortage alerts, and calculate replenishment signal reorder schedules.
home.modules_subtitle: Fully integrated tools for inventory planning, scenario testing, and supply intelligence.
home.ready_explore_desc: Sign in with pre-configured operational roles for Administrators, Inventory Managers, or Customers.
home.launch_subheading: Sign in with pre-configured operational roles for Administrators, Inventory Managers, or Customers.
home.footer_tagline: OrderWise — Deterministic inventory allocation and supply intelligence
